caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a backrest composed of seven vertically oriented, evenly spaced slats, each with a rounded top and slightly tapering toward the bottom. The frame of the bench, including the legs, seat, and supporting structures, is rendered in a dark, muted blue-black color, with visible shading and highlights suggesting a polished or worn surface. The bench features a straightforward rectangular seat divided into three segments, a horizontal support bar beneath the slats, and an additional decorative horizontal apron below the seat, which has a scalloped or wavy edge. The bench is supported by four straight legs, each reinforced with horizontal stretchers. The entire bench is set against a plain, light beige background. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Edward T. Jewitt" is written in small, clear capital letters.
title: Bench
